flags.title: Feature flags
flags.intro: Switch whole areas on or off, also in single regions only. Every change needs a reason and goes into the audit log.

community.name: Community
community.gates: Phase 3: posts, stories, comments and the Community area in navigation and profiles.

business-suite.name: Business Suite
business-suite.gates: Phase 2: advertising, billing, team and detailed statistics in the studio.

flags.disabledIn: {count, plural, one {Turned off in one region} other {Turned off in # regions}}
flags.enabledHint: Without a tick the area is off everywhere.
flags.disabledRegionsHint: Only applies while the flag is on.
flags.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. Goes into the audit log.

roles.title: Internal roles
roles.intro: Who has access to the admin. Only a super admin assigns roles, with a reason.
roles.caption: Accounts with an internal role
roles.editIntro: The change applies at once. Without a second factor the admin stays locked despite the role.
roles.emptyDescription: Search for an account below to give it a role.
roles.searchTitle: Find an account without a role
roles.searchIntro: For a new role: find the account, then edit its roles.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Security-relevant actions, newest first. The log contains no content, only action, target and reason.
audit.caption: Audit log entries
audit.count: {count, plural, =0 {No entries} one {One entry} other {# entries}}
audit.emptyDescription: Role changes, decisions, suspensions and access to sensitive data appear here.
audit.noMatchDescription: No entry matches the filters. Change or reset them.

status.title: Service status
status.intro: State of database, Redis, queues and migrations. Each check waits at most 2 seconds.
status.failures: {count, plural, one {One service does not respond} other {# services do not respond}}
status.failuresText: Details are in the table. The cause is in the Railway logs.
status.logsNote: Errors of single requests and jobs are in the Railway logs; the admin does not store them.
